services.name: Pawai Snorkel and Sail
services.desc: Adult (13+) - $89.00 plus tax Child (12 and under) - $79.00 plus tax 2 Hours About Want to go on a snorkel adventure but not interested in spending most of your day or your budget on a long tour? This is the perfect adventure for you. From Kamakahonu (located next to the Kailua Pier), it is a short boat ride to Pawai, which offers great views of beautiful coral and colorful fish. Join us on our historically accurate double hulled Hawaiian sailing canoe for a unique adventure that won’t break your 2 Hours • All Ages

services.name: Manta Ray Snorkel
services.desc: Hawaii’s #1 marine encounter!! Immerse yourself in the waters of Keauhou Bay to snorkel with majestic Manta Rays. Snorkel gear and floatation devices provided. We offer a Manta guarantee, if you do not see Manta Ray during your tour you can return for another tour during your stay at no cost (subject to availability). Adult - $118 Child - $108 Minimum of two people per booking Additional Information: Bring a jacket and towel for after the Adult $118, Child $108 · 1 Hour Snorkel

services.name: Hawaiian Sail and Snorkel
services.desc: Quick Details: 2.5 hours Ages: Minimum age for participants is 5 About Welcome to the only place in Hawaii where the spirit of ancient Hawaiian seafaring meets modern expectations on the pristine waters of the Kona coast. Immerse yourself in a unique and unforgettable experience as we invite you to join us for a 150-minute sail and snorkel on our traditional Hawaiian double-hull sailing canoe – the only commercial vessel of its kind. You will embark on a journey that transcends time, where you will glimpse how Hawaiians covered thousands of miles of open ocean and inter-island Adults and Children (5 and older) • 2.5 Hours
